thread:
noah-sales: Starting a POC request from BlueHarbor. They want to onboard a custom fine-tune 'cerulean-13b-ft' (HF checkpoint + custom BPE). Can eng/ML confirm catalog fit + risks?

anya-ml: Quick checks: does the bundle include adapter layers and tokenizer files? Tokenizer shape matters for batching.

noah-sales: Yes adapters + custom BPE. They want embedding->rerank flow, target steady ~40 req/s, typical gen 256 tokens. Also asked about BYOK and audit logs.

sam-eng: For 13B with 4k context fp16 VRAM ~25GB+ kv. Int8 quant variant would bring it into comfortable L4 margins. We should build int8 and fp16 catalog entries and pin the POC to the int8 route primarily.

anya-ml: Recommend eval plan: 1) tokenizer sample (500) -> token length dist, 2) quality delta fp16 vs int8 on 200 prompts, 3) KV prefix correctness on 100 sessions.

claire-legal: Flag: BYOK for model artifacts is only available on Dedicated/Private. We'll need model provenance and third-party license declarations. Long retention of logs is an add-on.

infra-bot: checklist: [TOKENIZER_SAMPLES], [QUANT_VARIANT], [KV_PREFIX_TEST], [BYOK_OK], [TEMP_CATALOG_ENTRY]

sam-eng: Perf sketch: assume batch=6, concurrency=5 for cost/latency model. Hosted might be fine for short POC, but Dedicated reserved will be cheaper for 30-day sustained load. I'll run numbers once we get tokenization distro.

noah-sales: Action items:
- noah: collect 500 token samples + model card (requested)
- anya: run quality delta fp16 vs int8 on 200 prompt set by EOD tomorrow
- sam: perf sketch + hosted vs dedicated 30-day delta by EOD tomorrow
- claire: draft BYOK + log retention addendum

anya-ml: quick note: if tokenizer causes tokenization spikes we lose batching efficiency - major cost/latency impact. If needed we can run tokenizer-sanity patch to align BPE mappings.

noah-sales: Thanks all. I'll schedule POC kickoff once we have the sample dump. :thumbsup:
